FP1.selection_rule: Mean of three validation binary log losses improves by >0.001 over current serving and both matched no-weather ablations (logistic and CatBoost); no target worsens by more than 5% versus current serving.
FP1.notice: Experimental fixed 72h-lead JMA weather plus prior nonfinish/circuit conditions. Historical weather publication is estimated with 6h release allowance. 2025 is a previously inspected development benchmark. No new source-shift certification. Unsupported stages or missing weather retain existing predictions.
